name.note: ISO 3166-1 codes the United Kingdom GB; UK is only reserved. The plan and design/v1 write UK.

default_units.note: PRD 03 §9 makes metric every household's default, and UK law is metric for trade (Weights and Measures Act 1985). Road distances stay in miles and everyday life keeps feet, pounds, stones and pints, which PRD 05 §11 (D-89) counts among what already serves the UK, so a UK household may switch to imperial, at the cost of °F. Starting GB in imperial would take a decision that amends PRD 03 §9.

holiday_set.note: England and Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland each have their own bank holidays, so Calendar needs the household's nation to offer the set in full.

inspection_label.note: Northern Ireland's MOT is the DVA's, and first falls due later; Vehicles (plan item 81) holds the cadence.

name.note: The Information Commissioner's Office became the Information Commission on 30 September 2026 (Data (Use and Access) Act 2025), and says it is still to be known as the ICO, which is what PRD 05 calls it. No other language has an established name for the new body, so each carries the English one.

url.note: The ICO's page for every complaint it takes; the one about how an organisation has used personal information is at /make-a-complaint/data-protection-complaints/ below it, which said it was under review when this was drafted.
